messages:
Dana K.: Quick update: new billing/quotas policy will go live Sep 12. Highlights: tiered soft rate limits, 7-day overage forgiveness for hosted metered customers, shortened trial credit expiry to 90 days, and a new consolidated monthly invoice CSV. Full docs: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/sep12 :mega:
Billing Bot: Doc published with CSV schema and examples: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/sep12/csv
Eng-Platform: We'll need rate-limit headers for SDKs. Proposal: X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit, -Remaining, -Reset, and -Policy. Anyone object?
Dana K.: Sounds good. Also adding X-Redwood-RateLimit-RetryAfter for ramped 429s. Please include retry guidance in SDK docs.
RevOps: Confirm Dedicated/reserved customers unaffected?
Dana K.: Correct. Reserved capacity and Dedicated contracts keep existing billing and QoS. Changes apply to hosted metered plans only.
Support: Action: update KB, canned replies, and dispute playbook. When's the AMA?
Dana K.: AMA scheduled Sep 5 10:00 PT. Rollout date Sep 12. Please review the doc and add questions in the AMA thread.
RevOps: How will overages appear on invoices?
Dana K.: Single monthly invoice with separate line items for overages; credits applied after totals. CSV samples in the doc.
Support: Noted. We'll queue KB updates and a customer-facing email draft.
